entities.title: Field-by-field adapter mappings
entities.summary: Mappings for RFC 5545 (with erratum 4271), RFC 7529, RFC 8984, RFC 9557 and ISO 8601-1/-2, with the ISO 8601-2 grammar checked against the licensed text.
entities.details: STANDARDS-MATRIX states the coverage class of each standard; the mappings themselves are not written. ISO 8601-2 grammar must be checked against the licensed normative text. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Each named standard has a field-by-field mapping to UTV with its fidelity level.

entities.title: Name the operations common questions need
entities.summary: difference, contains, fields, day-bounds, truncate, set-op, as-of, append-assertion, is-stale, format, canonicalize/digest and capabilities are needed but not named in RESULT-CONTRACT.
entities.details: docs/operations.md, Gaps in the specification, explains each. The everyday API's operation field already extends RESULT-CONTRACT's list (docs/everyday-api.md, Clarifications, item 5). Adding an operation is a minor change (1.1). Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: RESULT-CONTRACT's operation list names each of them, with its result shape.

entities.title: A shorter JSON authoring form
entities.summary: Let hand-written JSON omit defaults (the Gregorian proleptic calendar, nested schema) and normalize it to canonical form on read.
entities.details: Suggested by docs/aesthetics-review.md (R5). It changes what readers must accept, so it needs specification 1.1: a new schema file and reader rules. It was deliberately not done in the libraries ahead of the specification (docs/text-form.md, Considered and deferred). The display-oriented text form needs no specification change and is done. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Specification 1.1 defines the authoring form and the normalization, with a schema file for it.
